a.xlink:title: GTFS:Attribution: An organisation credited for the data of the feed, such as its producer, operator or authority, with copyright and…
GTFS:Agency: A transit agency whose services are described in the feed.
GTFS:AppliesToAgency: Links an attribution record to the agency it applies to.
GTFS:Routes: A public transit line: a group of trips shown to riders as a single service.
GTFS:appliesToRoute: Links an attribution record to the route to which it applies.
GTFS:Trips: A journey of a vehicle along a route at a given time, serving a sequence of stops.
GTFS:AppliesToTrip: Links an attribution record to the trip it applies to.
GTFS:FareTransferRule: A rule for the cost of a transfer between two fare legs (GTFS-Fares v2).
GTFS:FareLegRule: A fare rule for one leg of a journey (GTFS-Fares v2), defined by origin and destination areas, network and time frames.
GTFS:appliesToLegGroup: Links a fare transfer rule to the fare leg rules (leg group) it applies to.
GTFS:Area: A geographical area that groups stops, used to define fares by origin and destination areas.
GTFS:coversArea: Links a fare leg rule to an area that it covers.
GTFS:hasDestinationArea: Links a fare leg rule to the destination area at which the fare leg ends.
GTFS:hasOriginArea: Links a fare leg rule to the origin area from which the fare leg starts.
GTFS:TimeFrame: A time period (time of day and service days) during which a fare applies.
GTFS:hasEndTimeframeGroup: Links a fare leg rule to the timeframe group that applies to the fare validation event at…
GTFS:hasStartTimeframeGroup: Links a fare leg rule to the timeframe group that applies to the fare validation event at…
GTFS:FareProduct: A fare product that riders can buy, such as a single ticket or a pass.
GTFS:hasFareProduct: Links a fare leg rule to the fare product that it applies.
GTFS:hasAgency: Links a route to the agency that operates it.
GTFS:FareRule: A rule that says when a fare applies, based on the route, the origin, the destination or the zones a rider passes…
GTFS:hasFareRule: Links a route to a fare rule that applies to it.
GTFS:Network: A group of routes, used in particular to define fares by network.
GTFS:partOfNetwork: Links a route to the network it belongs to.
GTFS:hasRoute: Links a trip to the route it belongs to.
GTFS:operatesOnRoute: Links a trip to the route on which it operates.
GTFS:StopTimes: The scheduled time at which a trip serves a stop: arrival time, departure time and position of the stop in the trip.
GTFS:hasStopTime: Links a trip to one of its stop times.
GTFS:Shapes: The path that a vehicle travels along a route, as an ordered sequence of points.
GTFS:followsShape: Links a trip to the shape that its vehicle follows.
GTFS:Calendar: The days of the week on which a service runs, between a start date and an end date.
GTFS:usesService: Links a trip to the service calendar that says on which days it runs.
GTFS:Frequency: A headway-based service, whose trips run at regular intervals instead of following a fixed timetable.
GTFS:isScheduledBy: Links a trip to the frequency (headway) definition that schedules it.
GTFS:BookingRule: The booking rules of a service that must be booked in advance, such as on-demand transport: how, when and how far ahead…
GTFS:appliesTotrip: Links a booking rule to a trip it applies to.
GTFS:belongsToTrip: Links a stop time to the trip it belongs to.
GTFS:hasBookingRule: Links a stop time record to the booking rule that governs it.
GTFS:Stops: A stop or a station where vehicles pick up or drop off riders. Stops of the regular network and DRT stops are both…
GTFS:servesStop: Links a stop time to the stop that it serves.
GTFS:Level: A physical level of a station, such as a floor of a multimodal station or of a multi-storey car park.
GTFS:definesLevelFor: Links a level to a stop located on that level.
GTFS:isServedAtTime: Links a stop to a stop time at which it is served.
GTFS:stopInArea: Links a stop to an area that contains or groups it.
GTFS:hasParentStation: Links a stop to its parent station.
GTFS:Location: A zone, given as a GeoJSON polygon, where riders can request a pickup or a drop-off (GTFS-Flex).
GTFS:hasLocation: Links a stop to a GTFS-Flex zone (location) associated with it.
GTFS:isLocatedIn: Links a stop to a zone (location) in which it is located.
GTFS:LocationGroup: A group of stops where a rider may request a pickup or a drop-off (GTFS-Flex).
GTFS:stopInLocationGroup: Links a stop to the location group to which it belongs.
GTFS:Pathway: A link between two locations of a station, such as a walkway, stairs, an escalator or an elevator.
GTFS:fromStop: Links a pathway to the stop where the pathway starts.
GTFS:ToStop: Links a pathway to the stop where the pathway ends.
GTFS:Transfer: A rule for connections between routes, trips or stops, such as a minimum transfer time.
GTFS:hasDestinationRoute: Links a transfer rule to the destination route to which the transfer leads.
GTFS:hasOriginRoute: Links a transfer rule to the origin route from which the transfer starts.
GTFS:hasDestinationTrip: Links a transfer rule to the destination trip to which the transfer leads.
GTFS:hasOriginTrip: Links a transfer rule to the origin trip from which the transfer starts.
GTFS:hasDestinationStop: Links a transfer rule to the destination stop where the transfer ends.
GTFS:hasOriginStop: Links a transfer rule to the origin stop where the transfer begins.
GTFS:isApplicableDuring: Indicates that the time period described by timeframes applies to the service days…
GTFS:CalendarDates: An exception to a service calendar on a given date, for example a service added or removed on a public holiday.
GTFS:hasException: Links a calendar exception to the service calendar that it modifies.
GTFS:hasExeption: Links a service calendar to one of its exception dates.
GTFS:FareAttribute: A fare (GTFS-Fares v1): its price, currency, payment method and transfer conditions.
GTFS:usesFareAttribute: Links a fare rule to the fare that it applies.
GTFS:hasStop: Links a location group to a stop that it contains.
GTFS:managedBy: Links a fare to the agency that manages it.
GTFS:FareMedia: A medium that holds or validates a fare product, such as a smart card, a paper ticket or a mobile app.
GTFS:offersupportTo: Links a fare medium to a fare product that it can hold.
